notes: I rewrote the model to (1) fix the threshold at |x|=6 (E4 shows x=5 is flat, x=6 is already rising), and (2) add a cubic correction for |x|>80, since the data is clearly sub-quadratic at large x (E3, E4, E5 all show values well below 3.48·x² at |x|≥100). The correction term was fit to the three large-x points in E4 and reproduces them to within a few units.
